contentList.content: Hold up to 3 Quas (ice), Wex (storm) or Exort (fire) orbs, then Invoke the spell they match. Grants ten combination spells, Arcane Strike, an extra action each turn, and bonus spell slots (one 3rd level, two 2nd level).
Gain a Quas (ice) orb. Each Quas orb held restores 1 HP at the start of your turn in combat. Hold up to 3 orbs.
Gain a Wex (storm) orb. Each Wex orb held makes movement cost 10% less and gives +1 Initiative. Hold up to 3 orbs.
Gain an Exort (fire) orb. Each Exort orb held adds +1 force damage to your attacks and Arcane Strike. Hold up to 3 orbs.
Cast the spell that matches your held orbs.
EEE: Strike a point you can see for fire damage, even without line of sight. Creatures within 2 m take full damage and enemies out to 4 m take less. No saving throw. Needs 3 Exort orbs.
EEE: Strike a point you can see for fire damage, even without line of sight. The damage is rolled once and split evenly between all creatures within 2 m. No saving throw. Needs 3 Exort orbs.

QQQ: Deals cold damage now and each turn, and slows the target. A target that fails a Constitution save is hit for 3 turns and frozen for 1 turn. A target that passes is hit for 1 turn. Needs 3 Quas orbs.

QWE: Thunder damage in a cone. A creature that fails a Constitution save is pushed back and has disadvantage on attack rolls for 1 turn. A creature that passes takes half damage. Needs 1 Quas, 1 Wex and 1 Exort.
Takes [1] each turn. Movement reduced by 3 m.

WWW: Lightning damage in a 3 m area. Creatures that fail a Constitution save take full damage and are Silenced for 2 turns. Creatures that pass take half damage and are Silenced for 1 turn. Needs 3 Wex orbs.
WEE: A meteor hits a 3 m area for thunder damage (Dexterity save for half). Creatures hit burn for 3 turns, and a fire field is left on the ground. Needs 1 Wex and 2 Exort orbs.
WWE: For 3 turns, one creature gets an extra action, double movement speed, +2 AC, advantage on Dexterity saves, +1d4 to attack rolls and +1d6 damage. Needs 2 Wex and 1 Exort orb.

QQW: Turn invisible until you attack or cast a spell (orbs and Invoke do not break it). You gain +3 m movement, +2 AC, advantage on Stealth and freedom of movement. Enemies within 3 m are slowed and take fire damage. Needs 2 Quas and 1 Wex.
QQE: Draw a wall of ice up to 6 m long that lasts 3 turns. You can walk through it. Enemies near it are slowed and take fire damage that grows with your level. Needs 2 Quas and 1 Exort.
QWW: Summon a cyclone for 3 turns. Enemies inside are slowed, knocked prone when they enter, and take force damage each turn. Needs 1 Quas and 2 Wex.
QEE: Summon two fire elemental spirits for 4 turns. They get stronger as you level. Needs 1 Quas and 2 Exort.
A forged fire spirit empowers you: attacks deal +1d6 fire damage and you resist fire.
Ranged spell attack that deals force damage. Damage grows with your level.
Grants Arcane Strike and +1 Intelligence while worn.
